description: This file defines a generic Java class 'Digraph' that implements a directed graph data structure with methods for topological sorting and cycle detection.

classes.name: Digraph
classes.description: A utility class representing a directed graph with topological sorting and cycle detection capabilities.

methods.name: Digraph
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the graph from a map specification, validating that all nodes are declared.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Performs a topological sort of the graph assuming it is acyclic, throwing an exception if a cycle is detected.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Helper method for depth-first traversal used in topological sorting, detecting cycles.
